gold.title: The update and destroy methods in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController do not validate the existence of the EmbeddableHost r
gold.description: The update and destroy methods in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController do not validate the existence of the EmbeddableHost record retrieved by ID. If EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first returns nil (i.e., the host does not exist), attempting to call methods on the nil object (e.g., save_host or destroy) will result in a NoMethodError.

candidate.title: Admin host endpoints 500 on missing params or unknown id
candidate.description: `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` with no nil guard; `POST` without `host` param raises `NoMethodError` and returns 500. `embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:16` calls `host.destroy` on `where(id: ...).first` with no presence check, so `DELETE` with stale id 500s. Fix: use `self.host = host.to_s.sub(...)` and guard lookups with presence checks.

gold.title: record_for_host compares lower(host) = ? but does not normalize the parameter’s case, so mixed‑case referer hosts may fa
gold.description: record_for_host compares lower(host) = ? but does not normalize the parameter’s case, so mixed‑case referer hosts may fail to match even though comparison intends to be case‑insensitive.

candidate.title: `lower(host) = ?` never downcases the parameter
candidate.description: `URI#host` preserves case, so mixed-case hosts in Referer headers never match the lowercase query. The parameter itself is never downcased despite `lower()` in SQL. Fix: `where("lower(host) = ?", host.downcase).first`.

gold.title: Because this migration inserts embeddable_hosts rows with raw SQL, any existing embeddable_hosts values that include htt
gold.description: Because this migration inserts embeddable_hosts rows with raw SQL, any existing embeddable_hosts values that include http:// or /https:// or path segments won’t go through the EmbeddableHost model’s normalization, so the new host lookup (which compares only the bare host) may fail for migrated data. Consider ensuring that migrated hosts are normalized to the same format as newly created EmbeddableHost records so existing embedding configurations keep working.

candidate.title: Migration copies host values verbatim, migrated hosts never match new lookup
candidate.description: Migration inserts raw SQL, bypassing the `before_validation` callback that strips schemes/paths. Rows land as `http://discourse.org` but `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares against `URI(referer).host` (`discourse.org`), so no match. Values with `'` also break the interpolated INSERT. Fix: normalize in Ruby before inserting with `h.sub(/\Ahttps?:\/\//, '').sub(/\/.*\z/, '').strip` and use `quote(h)`.

promotion_candidates.title: Migration aborts on every site that never set `embed_category`
promotion_candidates.description: `execute(...)[0]['id']` indexes row 0 unconditionally. `embed_category` defaults to `''` and is only persisted when overridden, so the `INNER JOIN` returns zero rows for almost every install. `PG::Result#[]` raises `IndexError`, aborting the migration. Line 15 has the same issue. Fix: guard both queries with `if rows.cmd_tuples > 0`, defaulting to `0`.

promotion_candidates.title: Fabricator file contents are swapped
promotion_candidates.description: `category_fabricator.rb` contains only `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains all category fabricators. Tests pass due to directory loading, but editing a category fabricator opens the wrong file. Fix: swap the two files' contents back.

promotion_candidates.title: `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` and `saveChanges` action are no-ops
promotion_candidates.description: `#update` re-renders `@embedding` without writing anything; `admin-embedding.js.es6:5` calls `.update({})` against it. Route reads as a working save endpoint but does nothing. Fix: drop `saveChanges`, `EmbeddingController#update`, and the `put "customize/embedding"` route until there is state to save.
